steps.caption: This is croft. A file opens in a tab, highlighted, with a language server behind it. Press Enter to go on, Esc to leave the tour at any time.
Cmd+P finds any file by a few letters of its name. Type 'app' and press Enter, or press Esc to close it.
Cmd+\ splits the editor so two files sit side by side.
Ctrl+` opens a real terminal inside croft. It runs your shell, in this folder.
Commands run right here. This one checks app.py, and it has a mistake in it.
croft reads the error in the terminal and takes you to the line. Cmd+click does the same on any file:line you see.
Cmd+Shift+P is the command palette: every command croft has, searchable.
Pick a colour theme with the arrows. Enter keeps it.
That is the tour. Press Enter to finish; the sample project is removed and you are back in croft.
